ideas.title: Investigation into Trump administration's actions on Gateway Tunnel Project funding
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's attempt to freeze funding for the Gateway Tunnel Project and the subsequent federal judge ruling against it.
ideas.angle: The story would explore the implications of the Trump administration's actions and the potential abuse of power.
questions: What were the Trump administration's motivations for freezing funding?
How did the federal judge's ruling impact the project?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it raises concerns about the Trump administration's actions and potential abuse of power. The Gateway Tunnel Project is a significant infrastructure project, and the funding freeze could have had major implications for the project's completion.

ideas.title: Campaign finance investigation into US Representative Ruben Gallego
ideas.description: This story would investigate the campaign finance violations alleged against US Representative Ruben Gallego.
ideas.angle: The story would explore the implications of the allegations and potential misuse of funds.
questions: What were the specific allegations against Gallego?
How did Gallego respond to the allegations?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it raises concerns about the integrity of Gallego's campaign and potential misuse of funds. Campaign finance violations can have serious implications for politicians and their campaigns.
